jobs.title: Director of Finance - Service Parts & Lifecycle Solutions
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
The Director of Finance, Service Parts & Lifecycle Solutions serves as the strategic finance leader for GE HealthCare's global Parts, Repair, Asset Recovery, and Lifecycle Solutions business. This role partners directly with business leadership to drive profitable growth, margin expansion, inventory productivity, pricing excellence, and operational performance across a complex global services environment.

The leader will own financial strategy, planning, reporting, and business decision support for a multibillion-dollar service parts and lifecycle franchise, while driving transformation initiatives that improve customer value, operational efficiency, and free cash flow generation.

GE HealthCare is a $20B publicly traded global med-tech company focused on diagnostic and digital solutions. With more than 50,000 employees across 160+ countries, GE HealthCare serves over 1 billion patients worldwide. Founded in 2023 as a spin-off from GE, we combine a strong heritage of innovation with the agility of a new growth-oriented public company.

Job Description

The Director of Finance, Service Parts & Lifecycle Solutions serves as the strategic finance leader for GE HealthCare's global Parts, Repair, Asset Recovery, and Lifecycle Solutions business. This role partners directly with business leadership to drive profitable growth, margin expansion, inventory productivity, pricing excellence, and operational performance across a complex global services environment.

Responsibilities

Strategic Business Partnership
- Serve as the primary finance partner to the General Managers and senior leadership team for Service Parts & Lifecycle Solutions.
- Translate business strategies into actionable financial plans that accelerate growth, expand margins, and improve cash flow.
- Provide fact-based recommendations on strategic investments, pricing actions, inventory strategies, and portfolio optimization.

Financial Planning & Performance Management
- Lead annual operating plan, quarterly forecasts, long-term strategy (LTS), and monthly business reviews.
- Drive rigorous forecasting, variance analysis, and performance reporting across revenue, margin, inventory, and operating expenses.
- Deliver clear insights and recommendations to senior leadership regarding business risks and opportunities.

Parts, Repair & Lifecycle Economics
- Own financial performance of service parts, repair operations, asset recovery, and lifecycle solutions offerings.
- Drive initiatives that improve repair productivity, harvest economics, inventory turns, fulfillment performance, and overall profitability.
- Partner with operations, sourcing, logistics, and commercial teams to optimize end-to-end financial performance.

Pricing & Commercial Excellence
- Support development and deployment of pricing strategies that improve value capture and competitive positioning.
- Analyze pricing performance, discount trends, renewal opportunities, and market dynamics to identify growth levers.
- Evaluate business cases and investment opportunities to ensure sustainable returns and alignment with strategic objectives.

Working Capital & Cash Flow
- Lead inventory and working capital initiatives across the service parts ecosystem.
- Drive actions that improve inventory productivity, reduce excess and obsolete inventory, and enhance free cash flow generation.
- Establish performance metrics and governance mechanisms to sustain improvements.

Governance, Compliance & Controllership
- Ensure financial reporting accuracy, compliance with GE HealthCare policies, and adherence to internal controls.
- Partner with Controllership to maintain strong financial governance and audit readiness.
- Drive transparency and accountability across key business metrics and financial commitments.

Transformation & Digitization
- Champion simplification, automation, AI-enabled analytics, and digital finance capabilities.
- Improve reporting infrastructure, forecasting processes, and decision-support tools.
- Drive adoption of modern financial dashboards and data-driven operating mechanisms.

Team Leadership
- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing global finance organization.
- Build organizational capability through talent development, succession planning, and continuous improvement.
- Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and innovation.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. Master's degree (MBA) or CPA preferred.
- 10 years of progressive experience in finance roles, with at least 5 years in a leadership position within a complex, global organization.
- Demonstrated experience in financial planning and analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and strategic financial management.
- Strong understanding of service parts operations, supply chain finance, and inventory management principles.
- Proven ability to partner with business leaders and translate financial data into actionable business insights.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
- Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex financial information clearly to diverse audiences.
- Experience with large ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.
- Experience in the healthcare or medical device industry is a significant plus.

GE HealthCare is a $20B publicly traded global med-tech company focused on diagnostic and digital solutions. With more than 50,000 employees across 160+ countries, GE HealthCare serves over 1 billion patients worldwide. Founded in 2023 as a spin-off from GE, we combine a strong heritage of innovation with the agility of a new growth-oriented public company.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership –always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Ultrasound Probes
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Pilote des initiatives visant à améliorer l’efficacité de la fonction Ingénierie et collabore avec les autres fonctions afin d’assurer une coordination efficace des indicateurs de performance, des tableaux de bord, des processus fonctionnels et des initiatives transverses. A un impact sur les approches, projets et programmes de son domaine fonctionnel ou de l’organisation concernée, ainsi que sur les méthodes de travail. Contribue à la qualité, à l’efficacité et à la performance de son équipe. Joue un rôle important dans la définition des priorités. Travaille dans le cadre de pratiques professionnelles et de politiques influencées par la nature du poste. Dispose d’une autonomie modérée et doit faire preuve d’un solide jugement opérationnel.

Drives initiatives to improve the effectiveness of the Engineering function and interfaces with other functions to provide effective coordination of metrics, dashboards, functional processes, and cross-functional initiative coordination. Impacts approaches, projects and programs in the functional area or affected business organization and ways of working. Impacts quality, efficiency and effectiveness of own team. Has significant input into priorities. Guided by professional practices and policies that are shaped by the role. The role has moderate autonomy, requiring high levels of operational judgment.

Job Description

Role Summary

The Senior Program Manager - Ultrasound Probes will lead complex, cross-functional programs across the global Probes organization. This role spans the full Probes portfolio and will work closely with Probes segment leaders, who serve as Product Managers, to translate business and portfolio priorities into disciplined execution.

The Senior Program Manager will drive strategic and operational initiatives across R&D, Product Management, Supply Chain, QARA, Manufacturing, Service, and Regions. Key areas of focus include complex NPI programs, Hoshin Kanri deployment, operating rhythm improvements, and embedding the HeartBeat operating principle into NPIs and other cross-functional programs.
This role requires a strong operational leader who can bring structure to complexity, align diverse stakeholders, manage multiple workstreams and swimlanes, and drive execution with rigor and transparency.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Execution

- Lead complex, cross-functional programs across the Ultrasound Probes organization, including NPIs, portfolio priorities, operational initiatives, and strategic deployment activities.
- Translate business priorities into clear program plans with defined scope, milestones, owners, deliverables, risks, and decision points.
- Manage multiple workstreams and swimlanes, ensuring strong execution discipline, timely escalation, and clear accountability.
- Establish and maintain program governance, dashboards, operating rhythms, and leadership review mechanisms.

Partnership with Segment Leaders / Product Managers

- Work closely with Probes segment leaders / Product Managers to align program execution with portfolio strategy, customer needs, product roadmaps, and business priorities.
- Support prioritization, trade-off discussions, resource alignment, and decision-making across segments and functions.
- Ensure product and segment priorities are translated into executable plans across R&D, Supply Chain, QARA, Manufacturing, Service, and Regions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Serve as a key integrator across R&D, Product Management, Supply Chain, QARA, Manufacturing, Service, Finance, and regional teams.

- Facilitate alignment across global stakeholders, ensuring objectives, risks, dependencies, and decisions are clearly understood.

- Influence without direct authority in a global matrix environment.

Hoshin Kanri, HeartBeat & Operating Rhythm

- Support deployment of Hoshin Kanri priorities across the Probes organization by translating strategic objectives into measurable action plans and governance routines.
- Embed the HeartBeat operating principle into NPI and cross-functional program execution.
- Drive standard work, disciplined operating mechanisms, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement across program teams.

Risk Management & Compliance

- Identify program risks, interdependencies, resource constraints, and execution barriers.
- Lead mitigation planning, escalation, and countermeasure execution.
- Ensure programs are executed in alignment with applicable quality, regulatory, and product development requirements in a medical device environment.

Stakeholder Communication

- Provide concise, data-driven updates to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
- Develop program dashboards, milestone reviews, risk summaries, and decision documents.
- Communicate complex issues clearly, including options, trade-offs, recommendations, and required decisions.

Qualifications & Experience

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Business, Operations, or related discipline.

- Significant experience in program management, project management, operations, product development, or business execution in a medical device, healthcare technology, life sciences, or similarly regulated industry.

- Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional, multi-site programs with multiple workstreams and stakeholders.

- Strong operational skillset, including program governance, milestone management, risk management, escalation, prioritization, and execution tracking.

- Experience working across functions such as R&D, Product Management, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Service, Finance, and Commercial/Regional teams.

- Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.

- Proven ability to influence without direct authority in a global matrix organization.

Desired Characteristics

- Advanced degree such as MBA, MSc, or equivalent experience.
- Program management certification or training such as PMP, Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or equivalent.
- Experience with medical device product development, design controls, design transfer, regulatory submissions, manufacturing readiness, or post-market support.
- Experience with ultrasound, imaging systems, probes, transducers, or related healthcare technologies.
- ·Experience with Hoshin Kanri, strategy deployment, operating rhythms, Lean management, or enterprise transformation.
- Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
- Strong problem-solving mindset, with the ability to bring clarity, structure, and momentum in complex environments.

·        Preferred location: Valbonne, France
·        The role is global in scope and may require travel to support program execution, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional collaboration.

Inclusion et diversité :

GE HealthCare est un employeur offrant l'égalité des chances où l'inclusion compte. Les décisions relatives à l'emploi sont prises sans tenir compte de l’origine nationale ou ethnique, de la religion, du sexe, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'identité ou de l'expression de genre, de l'âge, du handicap, du statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou d'autres caractéristiques protégées par la loi.
Nos rémunérations totales sont conçues pour libérer votre ambition en vous donnant la motivation et la flexibilité dont vous avez besoin pour transformer vos idées en réalités qui changent le monde. Nos salaires et nos avantages sociaux correspondent à tout ce que vous attendez d’une organisation ayant une dimension internationale, avec des possibilités de développement de carrière, dans une culture qui favorise la collaboration et le soutien.
A propos de nous :

GE HealthCare est l'un des leaders mondiaux dans le domaine des technologies médicales et des solutions numériques. Il permet aux cliniciens de prendre des décisions plus rapides et plus pertinentes à travers des équipements intelligents, des analyses de données, des applications et des services. Avec plus de 100 ans d'expérience dans le secteur de la santé et environ 47 000 employés dans le monde, la société est au centre d'un écosystème qui travaille pour une médecine de précision.Présent en France depuis 1987 avec aujourd’hui 2 800 collaborateurs, c’est un acteur solidement ancré dans l’hexagone à travers son empreinte industrielle, son centre de R&D et de production à Buc dans les Yvelines et des partenariats de recherche avec des entreprises et des centres de recherche français.

jobs.title: Service Operations General Manager, EAGM Zone
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
The EAGM Service Operations General Manager will be responsible for leading service delivery across the EAGM Region, driving customer experience, service quality, operational performance, Field and cost productivity, cash collection, margin expansion and strong P&L outcomes. This leader will build and execute a future-ready service delivery strategy across RCIS, TCA, MESA & Africa LCTs, supported by Global Markets Services and Global Services Standard operating framework that establishes standards, tools, systems, processes, KPIs and performance management routines.

The role requires a global, enterprise-minded service leader with deep experience leading complex large-scale service organizations, delivering P&L performance, improving field and remote service productivity, and building a high-performance culture for world class services. The ideal candidate will bring strong lean operating discipline, customer obsession, cross-functional leadership, and the ability to balance global standardization with market-specific execution needs.

This leader will play a critical role in strengthening customer outcomes while improving cost efficiency, cash performance, patient safety, employee safety, and employee experience. The role will drive the adoption of standard service delivery processes and tools, simplify and harmonize processes across LCTs where appropriate, and ensure that service delivery operates as one connected and accountable team across LCTs, EAGM leadership, and Global Markets.

Job Description
Essential Responsibilities
Service Delivery Strategy and Operating Model
- Lead the development and execution of the EAGM service delivery strategy, aligned to enterprise priorities, customer needs, and regional growth objectives.
- Analyze and understand the competition - ensure delivery and the service sales strategy are aligned
- Define and drive overall customer satisfaction indicators and levels.
- Translate global markets services and EAGM priorities into clear service delivery mechanisms, measurable outcomes, and disciplined execution routines.
- With utilization of standard service delivery processes, tools, Drive simplification, transformations and harmonization of service processes across LCTs, including business operations, service delivery, product service, field operations, customer experience, and patient, employee safety.
- Partner with Global Service Organization, EAGM leaders, AIS, Service Sales, OTR, Finance, HR, Quality, EHS, and Zone Presidents to ensure aligned strategy, clear interfaces, and accountable execution.
- Assess the effectiveness of service delivery through CSAT, benchmarking, and best practice sharing (applied time, time to repair, fix right first time, …etc.) and address main opportunities.

P&L, Productivity, and Operational Performance
- With Service Operations leadership team, own/drive and develop operational and financial growth initiatives and targets, cost control measures, contribution margin, cash, billing, contract execution support, warranty, operational efficiency and process improvements.
- Develop metrics on field service profitability and resource models to maximize productivity while protecting customer experience, service quality, and frontline effectiveness.
- Lead operating reviews and daily management systems to monitor performance, identify gaps, and drive corrective actions.
- Improve field and remote service productivity through standard work, capacity management, resource optimization, digital tools, and continuous improvement.
- Drive operational rigor across installed base, installations, contracts, warranty, point of sale, billing, ODS, cost, cash, productivity, and service execution metrics.
- Ensure the service delivery model enables strong performance across modalities and product segments.
- Build a working environment which values teamwork to the overall benefit of customer satisfaction and growth. Support large strategic deals in regions and POS strategy

Customer Experience, Quality, and Escalation Management
- Build and maintain strong customer relationships by ensuring consistent, high-quality service delivery across all LCTs. Provide leadership and direction in crucial customer interfaces.
- Own customer CSO escalations and drive for fast and effective resolution. In conjunction with EAGM Service PSD, LCT Leaders and Commercial Product Managers (equipment sales)
- Drive continuous improvement in customer experience, including CSAT, time to resolution, first-call resolution, service quality, and escalation management.
- Ensure customer escalations are managed with urgency, ownership, transparency, and strong cross-functional coordination
- Create one consistent customer-facing service experience where possible, while preserving necessary market, regulatory, clinical, and technical specialization. at direct and indirect markets.
- Use service business intelligence, performance data, customer feedback, and operating reviews to identify systemic issues and drive sustainable improvements.

Lean, Heartbeat, and Continuous Improvement
- Champion Heartbeat and the GEHC business system across Service Delivery, with a strong emphasis on the core four, standard work, daily management, problem solving, and operating cadence.
- Lead by example in deploying lean management, visual management, bowler/KPI discipline, root-cause problem solving, and continuous improvement.
- Establish clear performance standards, governance mechanisms, and accountability routines across zones and central service teams.
- Drive process improvement across service delivery, field operations, remote service, customer operations, service quality, digital tools, training, and extended channels.
- Create a culture where teams use data, standard work, and customer feedback to solve problems at the source.

Organizational Leadership and Culture
- Lead, coach, mentor, and develop LCT and Zone service leaders to ensure alignment with enterprise priorities, operating standards, cultural expectations, and customer commitments.
- Recruit top talent leaders and successfully develop, engage and coach them for roles of increasing responsibility.
- Build a positive, inclusive, high-performance culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, servant leadership, safety, quality, and enterprise-first decision making.
- Strengthening leadership capability across the service organization, with a focus on service execution, customer orientation, change leadership, and talent development.
- Ensure the organization has the right structure, spans, layers, capabilities, and operating mechanisms to deliver current commitments and future growth.
- Lead through transformation with transparency, resilience, and strong change management.

Cross-Functional Partnership
- Build a working environment which values teamwork to the overall benefit of customer satisfaction and growth. Support large strategic deals in regions and POS strategy
- Partner closely with Service Sales to support service growth, renewal execution, customer retention, and commercial operating rhythms, while maintaining clear accountability between sales capture and service delivery execution.
- Collaborate with Global Markets Operation, COO and GSO to deploy standards, tools, training, global parts interfaces, service quality processes, and customer escalation mechanisms.
- Work with Global Markets Operation, PSD & EAGM Zone product/segment leaders to improve serviceability, reliability feedback loops, product service performance, customer outcomes, and modality-specific operating needs.
- Partners with EAGM OTR, HPM, Commercial Operations, Finance, HR, Quality, Regulatory, Compliance, Legal, Digital, IT, Security, Zone & Global ITC and EHS to ensure strong execution across the full customer lifecycle.
- Support budgeting, long-term strategy, LTS, BPR processes, operating reviews, and resource planning for the zone

Safety, Compliance, and Risk Management
- Promote a safe work environment and ensure full compliance with all applicable EHS policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
- Drive operational discipline across quality, compliance, service documentation, training, escalation management, and customer commitments.
- Identify and mitigate operational & other security risks associated with organizational consolidation, market complexity, service disruption, customer impact, and loss of specialized focus.
- Ensure that service delivery remains connected to local market needs, especially in large, complex, indirect and or small-scale services organizations with prioritization together with LCT leadership.

Key Outcomes / Measures of Success
- Service P&L performance, contribution margin, fixed cost productivity, and cash outcomes.
- Customer experience, CSAT, escalation resolution, Strategic, Key Account Management, service quality
- Standard work adoption and Heartbeat operating discipline.
- Patient and Employee Safety, quality, compliance, and EHS performance.
- Service delivery consistency across zones.
- Contract, warranty, billing, ODS, installed base, and cost/cash execution.
- Field, material, OVC and remote service productivity.
- Talent development, leadership effectiveness, and organizational health.
- Successful simplification of the service delivery model without disruption to customers or frontline teams.
- Delivery of committed financial and productivity targets.

Qualifications/Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree (BA/BS)
- Extensive experience working in Healthcare Services, Service delivery, Technical Operations, OTR or supply chain management
- 10+ years of senior level sales management, product, and/or general management experience
- Proven business/financial acumen, including demonstrated ability to motivate, influence, solve complex problems, and drive change at all levels of the organization
- Extensive experience in process improvement, lean, project management, and solid analytical skills
- Willingness and ability to travel within international geography
- Proven leadership and ability to orchestrate resources and motivate teams and experience of managing remote teams and influencing organizations
-  An inclusive leader who builds a connection to the workforce through personal involvement and trust
- Good balance of strategic thinking and strong operating rigor
- Ability to influence, effectively understand and manage diversity (cultural, nationality, religion, gender, other) engage as a horizontal team player and drive change across-functionally in a highly matrixed environment
- Ability to operate effectively in a multi-tasking, dynamic environment, while maintaining a forward thinking and customer-first attitude
- Demonstrated tendency to challenge the status quo and drive constant improvement in process and ability to achieve organizational goals
- Excellent communication, influencing, and team-building skills. Must be highly skilled at written and verbal communication both inside the company and with external customers
- Servant leader – serves team by connecting at all levels and removing barriers for optimal engagement and business results
- Unyielding personal Integrity translating into culture of transparency and compliance
- Lean practitioner
- Fluency in English language

Desired Qualifications/Requirements
- Master’s/MBA degree.
- MedTech Industry experience beyond the GEHC product and solution portfolio
- Familiarity with other GE HealthCare segments and supply chain structures
- This is multi-location posting as the role can be conducted from any country within EAGM. The final location will be the successful candidate's location or mutually agreed alternative location within EAGM.

Job Description Summary
The HR Business Partner, Mergers & Acquisitions and Business Development plays a critical role in accelerating the company's growth strategy through acquisitions, divestitures, partnerships, and other business development activities. This role leads the people workstream throughout the transaction lifecycle, including HR due diligence, organization and talent assessment, retention planning, Day 1 readiness, and post-close integration. - Lead workforce planning, organization design, job alignment, and integration of talent processes.

- Develop employee communication, engagement, and change management plans supporting successful integrations and divestitures. Partner with leaders to drive transparency, engagement and trust during organizational change.

- Provide expert guidance to business leaders on people-related M&A matters and integration best practices.

jobs.title: Operations Manager Germany Pharmaceutical Diagnostics (PDx) f/m/d
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft im Gesundheitswesen!

Bei GE HealthCare entwickeln wir innovative Medizintechnologien und pharmazeutische Diagnostika, die Ärztinnen und Ärzte dabei unterstützen, schnellere und fundiertere Entscheidungen für ihre Patientinnen und Patienten zu treffen.

Zur Verstärkung unserer deutschen Organisation suchen wir einen Operations Manager (m/w/d), der analytisches Denken mit operativer Exzellenz verbindet und Freude daran hat, gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen die Leistungsfähigkeit unseres Vertriebs kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

In dieser zentralen Funktion arbeiten Sie eng mit dem General Manager Deutschland sowie den Sales Managern zusammen. Sie schaffen Transparenz, koordinieren wesentliche Planungsprozesse und liefern fundierte Analysen als Grundlage für unternehmerische Entscheidungen. Gleichzeitig treiben Sie die Weiterentwicklung unserer kommerziellen Prozesse, Systeme und digitalen Lösungen aktiv voran.

Sie übernehmen eine Schlüsselrolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb, Finance, Supply Chain und dem General Manager Deutschland und leisten einen wesentlichen Beitrag zu einer datenbasierten und effizienten Steuerung unseres Deutschlandgeschäfts.

Der Arbeisort ist hombased oder office based, eine Nähe zu unserem GE HealthCare Office in München, Berlin oder Düsseldorf ist von Vorteil aber nicht zwingend.

Job Description
Ihre Aufgaben
- Steuerung und Koordination des Forecast-Prozesses sowie der kommerziellen Business-Planung
- Organisation und Moderation des monatlichen Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)-Prozesses in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Finance, Supply Chain und regionalen Teams
- Erstellung aussagekräftiger Analysen, Dashboards und Management-Reports zur Unterstützung strategischer und operativer Entscheidungen.
- Analyse von Geschäftsentwicklungen sowie Identifikation von Chancen, Risiken und Verbesserungspotenzialen
- Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung unserer kommerziellen Prozesse nach LEAN-Prinzipien sowie Umsetzung von Automatisierungs- und Digitalisierungsinitiativen zur nachhaltigen Steigerung von Effizienz und Transparenz
- Verantwortung für die Einführung, Nutzung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer kommerziellen Systeme und digitalen Tools, insbesondere Salesforce (SFDC), Power BI, SAP sowie weiterer Business-Anwendungen
- Sicherstellung konsistenter Reporting-Standards auf Basis hoher Datenqualität
- Unterstützung des Country General Managers und der Sales Manager bei Business Reviews, Performance-Analysen und Management-Präsentationen.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit regionalen und globalen Commercial Excellence-, Pricing-, Marketing- und Supply-Chain-Teams zur Umsetzung internationaler Initiativen

Ihr Profil

Sie verbinden analytische Stärke mit einer strukturierten Arbeitsweise und verstehen es, komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich aufzubereiten und bereichsübergreifend erfolgreich zusammenzuarbeiten.

Idealerweise bringen Sie mit:
- Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Naturwissenschaften, Life Sciences oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Fundierte Berufserfahrung in Commercial Operations, Sales, Commercial Excellence oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion
- Erfahrung im Forecasting, der Vertriebsplanung oder integrierten Business-Planungsprozessen
- Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge
- Sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse in Power BI, Salesforce (SFDC), SAP sowie modernen KI-gestützten Anwendungen zur Datenanalyse und Prozessoptimierung
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten sowie Erfahrung im Management bereichsübergreifender Projekte
- Eigeninitiative, eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, Veränderungen aktiv mitzugestalten
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Warum GE HealthCare?

Diese Position bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, einen direkten Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Deutschlandgeschäfts zu leisten.
Sie arbeiten eng mit der Geschäftsführung und den Vertriebsleitern zusammen, gestalten zentrale Geschäftsprozesse mit und tragen dazu bei, dass Entscheidungen auf einer belastbaren Datenbasis getroffen werden.
Freuen Sie sich auf:
- Eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselrolle mit hoher Sichtbarkeit innerhalb der Organisation.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit nationalen sowie internationalen Teams.
- Vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung.
- Ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld mit modernen digitalen Tools und internationalen Projekten.
- Die Chance, die Weiterentwicklung unserer Commercial Operations aktiv mitzugestalten und einen sichtbaren Beitrag zum Erfolg eines weltweit führenden Healthcare-Unternehmens zu leisten.

Wenn Sie analytisches Denken, operative Exzellenz und digitale Kompetenz miteinander verbinden und gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens gestalten möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Über uns

GE HealthCare ist ein global führender Innovator für Medizintechnik und digitale Lösungen mit mehr als 100 Jahren Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen und rund 50.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit. Wir ermöglichen es klinischen Anwendern, schnellere und besser informiertere Entscheidungen zu treffen durch intelligente Systeme, Datenanalyse, Anwendungen und Services, die durch unsere Edison Platform unterstützt sind. Wir agieren im Zentrum eines Ökosystems  einer Präzisionsmedizin, die das Gesundheitswesen digitaler gestaltet - für mehr Produktivität und bessere Ergebnisse für Patienten, Anbieter im Gesundheitswesen, ganze Gesundheitssysteme und die Forschung weltweit.

Unsere GE HealthCare Total Rewards sind dazu entwickelt worden, Sie zu Höchstleistungen zu inspirieren. Sie geben Ihnen den notwendigen Rückenwind und die Flexibilität, die Sie brauchen, um Ihre Ideen Realität werden zu lassen. Unsere Gehälter und Bonussysteme sind genau so, wie Sie es von einem Global Player in der Medizintechnik erwarten und Sie sind bei uns umgeben von Möglichkeiten in einer Unternehmenskultur, in der das füreinander Einsetzen, Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitige Unterstützung an erster Stelle stehen.

GE HealthCare ist ein Arbeitgeber mit gleichen Chancen für alle. Wir leben eine Kultur wo jeder dazu gehört und Personalentscheidungen werden bei uns unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion und Weltanschauung, Bekenntnis, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechteridentität, Alter, Behinderung und anderer gesetzlich geschützter Persönlichkeitsrechte getroffen.

Job Description Summary
This role provides quality oversight for AI and machine learning-enabled medical devices, including SaMD. The position supports the full product lifecycle, from design and development through software release, design transfer and post-market activities. Working across engineering, clinical, regulatory and program teams, the role applies design controls, risk management and quality-system requirements to ensure patient safety, product quality and compliance. It also supports investigations, CAPAs, audit remediation and continuous improvement while using sound technical judgement to resolve complex quality issues.

Job Description
Roles and Responsibilities
- Creates and promotes a strong quality culture by driving quality and compliance activities for AI-enabled medical devices, including Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). Responsible for ensuring compliance with the applicable Quality Management System, driving quality objectives and metrics, and supporting effective quality operating mechanisms across the business.
- Provides quality oversight throughout the product lifecycle, including new product introduction, design and development, design changes, software releases, design transfer and post-market activities. Ensures quality and regulatory compliance while supporting process effectiveness and efficiency.
- Develops in-depth knowledge of AI-enabled medical devices and their integration with compatible medical-device platforms. Uses prior experience and technical expertise to support quality strategy, risk-based decision-making, verification and validation, and the effective application of design controls.
- Partners with software engineering, machine learning, clinical, regulatory, product and program teams to provide quality guidance for AI-enabled medical-device development. Communicates complex quality and technical information clearly and provides guidance to less-experienced team members.
- Impacts projects, processes and procedures within the quality function and operates with appropriate autonomy. Uses professional judgement to identify and address quality and compliance risks, while seeking senior guidance for complex or high-impact matters when needed.
- Utilizes technical expertise and analytical thinking to resolve quality issues and support investigations, nonconformances, CAPAs, audit remediation and continuous-improvement activities. Leverages multiple internal sources and cross-functional input to make informed decisions.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (OR a high school diploma / GED with at least 10 years of experience.)
- 6+ years of experience

Desired Characteristics
- Strong oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.
- Experience supporting AI or machine learning-enabled medical devices, including considerations related to data quality, model performance, traceability, validation, change control and integration with medical-device platforms.
- Experience in quality assurance or design quality for medical devices, including SaMD, with working knowledge of design controls, software lifecycle processes, risk management, verification, validation and post-market quality activities.

Job Description Summary
The Total Rewards Business Partner for the Science & Technology and IT organizations develops and delivers integrated reward strategies for global technology and engineering teams, with particular focus on cloud, artificial intelligence and machine learning, data, platform engineering and advanced engineering talent. The role translates business strategy, workforce priorities and evolving skill needs into competitive, equitable and sustainable Total Rewards solutions that support growth, performance and colleague engagement.

This is a senior individual-contributor role that combines strategic advisory, program leadership, analytics and operational execution. Reporting to the Global Total Rewards Business Partner, the role works through influence across STO leadership, HR Business Partners, Zone Total Rewards Leaders, Talent Acquisition, Finance and Employee Relations. This is a senior individual-contributor role that combines strategic advisory, program leadership, analytics and operational execution. Reporting to the Global Total Rewards Business Partner, the role works through influence across STO leadership, HR Business Partners, Zone Total Rewards Leaders, Talent Acquisition, Finance and Employee Relations. Job Description
What you’ll do

Partner with business and HR leadership

•     Partner with the Global Total Rewards Business Partner to support the Chief Technology Officer, the Chief Information Officer and STO and CIO HR leadership and other senior leaders on high-impact compensation and talent decisions.

Shape technology compensation strategy and market positioning
•     Develop multi-year compensation perspectives for cloud, AI/ML, data and advanced engineering talent, considering global labor-market trends, skill evolution, regional cost structures and capability readiness.
•     Lead targeted market analyses across relevant competitors, including hyperscalers, software-as-a-service companies, specialized AI firms and medical-technology organizations; monitor skill premiums, equity practices, geographic hotspots and other market disruptions.
•     Translate market and workforce data into executive-ready scenarios, risk assessments and recommendations on pay competitiveness, regional differences and capability maturity over a three-to-five-year horizon.
•     Bring evidence-based thought leadership that helps shape GE HealthCare’s broader approach to technology compensation while operating within enterprise governance and philosophy.

Evolve technical job architecture and future-skills frameworks
•     Lead the STO and CIO workstreams to evolve global technical job families, including role scope, leveling, career paths, competency alignment and cross-functional consistency.
•     Partner with Corporate HR, Digital Technology and the broader engineering community to build a durable job architecture that accommodates emerging capabilities such as cloud, platform engineering, AI/ML and data science.
•     Establish practical governance, decision principles and manager guidance that maintain clarity as skills, operating models and organizational needs change.
•     Use job architecture, job evaluation, market benchmarking and workforce analytics to inform organization design, career development, talent mobility and compensation decisions.

Strengthen talent acquisition, retention and skills-based rewards
•     Partner with Talent Acquisition to create offer frameworks for hard-to-fill roles such as cloud platform architects, machine learning operations (MLOps) engineers and AI research engineers, and coach recruiters on the effective use of compensation levers.

•     Build evidence-based models that distinguish cloud builders from cloud users and AI/ML engineering roles from roles that implement AI-enabled technology; assess when skill premiums, role-based supplements, retention incentives or progression accelerators are appropriate.
•     Advise HR and business leaders on new-hire offers, promotions, retention, internal mobility and other critical talent decisions with consistent judgment and appropriate governance.

Integrate regional rewards and workforce economics
•     Collaborate with Zone Total Rewards Leaders to design and implement compensation and benefits changes, balancing global business priorities with local market, regulatory, employee-relations and operational requirements.
•     Partner with HR, Finance and business leaders on workforce-cost planning, headcount budgets, regional capability build-out, market benchmarking and union- or works-council-related reward matters where applicable.
•     Inform multi-year workforce plans with insights on skill transitions, geographic talent strategies, cloud and AI capability development, and the labor-cost implications of alternative operating models.

•     Develop executive-ready presentations and communication and change-management approaches that make complex reward, job-architecture and workforce decisions clear to leaders, managers and colleagues.

The Digital Marketing Manager, Contrast Media Portfolio is responsible for developing and implementing digital marketing campaigns and programs that leverage data, marketing automation, and AI-enabled technologies to enhance customer engagement, generate qualified sales opportunities, and improve campaign performance across the portfolio. This role manages and optimizes the digital ecosystem and marketing technology stack, including CRM, automation, analytics, content, and digital advertising platforms, to enable connected, compliant, and measurable customer experiences.

This individual contributor partners closely with Brand Management, Marketing Communications, Sales, IT, analytics, and external agencies to translate business priorities into targeted digital programs. The manager uses segmentation, personalization, A/B testing, campaign analytics, and lifecycle marketing to improve conversion, strengthen lead nurturing, and connect digital activity to commercial outcomes. The role also provides creative input and content guidance for campaigns, launches, and events.

GE HealthCare is a trusted partner and leading global healthcare solutions provider, innovating medical technology, pharmaceutical diagnostics, and integrated, cloud-first AI-enabled solutions, services and data analytics. We strive to create a healthier world by thinking big and unlocking opportunities for us, our customers, and their patients. We are driven by our purpose to create a world where healthcare has no limits. And we're committed to fostering an inclusive culture of respect, transparency, and integrity.

Job Description
Roles and Responsibilities
- Digital Marketing and Demand Generation: Develop and execute targeted digital marketing campaigns and programs that support portfolio priorities, customer engagement, lead generation, and revenue growth. Activate segmented and personalized outreach across paid search, retargeting, programmatic media, targeted display, email, social media, content marketing, and other relevant digital channels.
- Digital Tech Stack Optimization: Manage and optimize the digital marketing technology stack, including CRM, marketing automation, content and asset management, analytics, digital advertising, and AI-enabled solutions. Partner with appropriate stakeholders to improve system integration, data flow, governance, usability, and adoption.
- Digital Ecosystem Management and Engagement: Support maintenance of the Contrast Media Portfolio digital ecosystem, including a cohesive online presence across websites, social platforms, email programs, digital advertising, and other customer touchpoints. Ensure digital experiences align with portfolio strategy, brand standards, customer needs, and channel best practices.
- Campaign Planning and Activation: Partner with Brand Management and Marketing Communications to translate business objectives into integrated digital campaign plans.
- Performance Metrics and Analytics: Define and monitor campaign KPIs, including traffic, engagement, conversion, lead progression, cost per conversion, and customer journey performance. Use dashboards, A/B testing, contact management, and campaign analytics to identify insights, optimize investment, and recommend improvements.
- Lead Management and Sales Alignment: Collaborate with Sales and commercial partners to support lead management and align demand programs with field priorities, customer segments, and account strategies. Support effective lead capture, routing, nurturing, follow-up, and feedback processes to improve marketing contribution to the sales pipeline.
- Data Privacy and Compliance: Ensure digital marketing activities comply with applicable data privacy requirements, industry standards, GE HealthCare policies, and promotional review processes. Support appropriate data security, consent, documentation, and customer privacy practices across the digital ecosystem.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
- 7+ years of experience in digital marketing, marketing operations, revenue marketing, marketing automation, digital customer marketing, or a related field, preferably in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
- Proven track record of successfully managing and supporting multi-channel marketing campaigns from planning through execution, measurement, and optimization.
- Hands-on experience with digital marketing tools and software, including CRM, marketing automation, analytics, or related marketing technology.
- Strong organizational, communication, analytical, project management, and problem-solving skills.
- Knowledge of regulated promotional environments, digital privacy, consent, and compliant marketing practices preferred.

Desired Characteristics
- Experience developing and executing integrated digital campaigns that drive engagement, lead generation, conversion, revenue, and customer retention.
- Proficiency in managing and maintaining a digital marketing technology stack, including CRM systems, marketing automation platforms, content and asset management, analytics tools, and digital advertising platforms. Experience with Salesforce, Marketo, Adobe Experience Cloud, Power BI, Tableau, HubSpot, Eloqua, Knak, or comparable tools is preferred.
- Familiarity with AI-enabled tools for personalization, campaign optimization, workflow efficiency, predictive insights, and real-time data analysis.
- Experience integrating digital tools and platforms to create a compliant and seamless ecosystem that supports marketing and customer engagement goals.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to monitor, measure, and report on digital marketing performance and translate insights into campaign improvements.
- Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with Brand Management, Marketing Communications, Commercial Operations, Sales, IT, analytics, and agency partners.
- Exceptional project management, budgeting, prioritization, and organizational skills with the ability to manage concurrent workstreams.
- Strong written and verbal communication, negotiation, influencing, and problem-solving capabilities.
- Ability to exercise sound judgment, propose solutions outside standard parameters when appropriate, and bring stakeholders to consensus.
- Acts as a resource for colleagues with less digital marketing experience and may lead small to medium-sized projects with defined risk and resource requirements.

jobs.title: Global Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
GE Healthcare Pharmaceutical diagnostics (“PDx”) is currently recruiting a team-oriented, self-motivated, and enthusiastic Compliance professional with extensive pharmaceutical industry experience as part of the PDx Compliance team.

This position will report to a member of the GE HealthCare Pharmaceutical Diagnostics Compliance leadership team.

In this role, the Compliance Manager will provide a broad range of compliance support to the PDx business, partnering actively with the business to sustain GEHC PDx’s ethical and compliant culture and developing actionable solutions together with company.

S/he will also partner actively with GEHC Compliance colleagues across the entire organization on compliance matters as they relate to his/her area of responsibility.

This role offers the opportunity to work across broad and diverse regions, partnering with senior leaders and contributing to the continued evolution of the PDx compliance program.

Job Description
GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator with over 100 years of healthcare industry experience and around 50,000 employees globally.

We enable clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics, applications and services, supported by our Edison intelligence platform. We operate at the center of an ecosystem working toward precision health -digitizing healthcare, helping drive productivity and improving outcomes for patients, providers, health systems and researchers around the world.

Roles & Responsibilities

Business Partnering:

·       Partner closely with business leaders to advance and promote a culture of integrity and compliance throughout the PDx business.
·       Maintain an understanding of key compliance risks relevant to the PDx business and partner with the relevant business leaders to assess risks and support development of risk mitigation strategies and tactics.
·       Develop an advanced business acumen to provide actionable, proactive, and compliant business solutions.

Compliance Program Management :

·       Partner and ensure alignment with the GE Healthcare Compliance team to develop and/or manage key compliance programs, policies and local procedures applying specifically to PDx.
·       Implement and facilitate implementation of company-wide Compliance initiatives.
·       Maintain and/or create compliance metrics for operational reviews. Lead various compliance governance forums and committees including compliance review boards to address key compliance matters together and aiming at continuous improvement.
·       Support business groups in engagement and partnership with third parties to identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risks.
- Ensure execution of the key elements of the company’s compliance auditing and monitoring program, including: - Defining the relevant monitoring plan to ensure business activities comply with established policies, procedures, and legal requirements.
- Tracking and reporting results of the auditing and monitoring activities and the corrective actions taken to Compliance leadership and other internal key stakeholders as needed.
-

Employee Education & Communication:

·       Facilitate, create, and conduct when needed compliance education on healthcare compliance, relevant laws and Company policies and procedures
·       Develop and maintain communications that promote and reinforce a culture of integrity

Other:
- Partner with the Global transparency team to support the management of the company’s transparency reporting program for PDx, including country-specific transparency, disclosure and aggregate spend reporting requirements
- Partner with Global compliance colleagues on key projects and share best practices
- Be an active member of the PDx Legal and Compliance team and support GEHC PDX-wide initiatives.

Qualifications
- University degree in law, finance, business, or other professional areas. Master’s degree preferred.
- A minimum of 5 - 10 years’ professional experience with a pharmaceutical company in regional Compliance, risk mitigation, investigations, or audit.
- Mandatory multi-jurisdictional experience in Latin America and the United States
- Excellent drafting, writing and oral communication in English, Portuguese and Spanish.
- In-depth understanding of regulations/Code/ laws applying to PDx operations.
-

·       Expertise in international compliance/regulatory law and enforcement, including the Anti-Kickback Statute, False Claims Act, Food Drug & Cosmetic Act, US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA), UK Bribery Act, global anti-corruption laws, healthcare compliance laws and regulations, industry codes, transparency requirements, trade compliance and competition laws.

·       Proven track record of advanced leadership, influencing and collaboration skills, with the ability to successfully navigate complex matrixed organizational structures.
- Strong business acumen, ability to detect emerging compliance trends and develop appropriate responses

- Ability to lead the change, be self-motivated to manage sensitive issues, and be accountable for the results

- Highly proficient using Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

- Strong analytical, organizational, and strategic thinking skills.
- Ability to work effectively in a global environment and good at managing work under a matrix organization structure and comparably complicated environment.

·       Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced and evolving business environment.

·       Strong learning agility, strategic thinking and willingness to take on new challenges, develop expertise across new markets and business areas, and assume increasing levels of responsibility.

- Unquestioned integrity and ethics in business and personal conduct
- Ability to manage highly confidential information
- Able to travel within the region or internationally as required

Job Description Summary
As a Business Intelligence Analyst II, you will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Operations, Product, and other business functions to develop reporting solutions, dashboards, metrics, and analytics that help the organization understand performance, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions.

Using SQL, Power BI, and modern data modeling practices, you will develop and manage trusted data products through their full lifecycle, as well as building reporting assets and KPI frameworks that support business operations and strategic initiatives.

Your work will create impact by improving visibility into key business metrics, strengthening reporting and data governance practices, and enabling leaders to make decisions with confidence.

About MIM Software:
Our Cleveland site, home to MIM Software within GE HealthCare’s Advanced Imaging Solutions segment, develops AI-enabled imaging analytics and workflow platforms that help clinicians turn complex medical images into meaningful insights, so they can diagnose conditions, plan treatments, and deliver more personalized patient care.

https://www.mimsoftware.com/

**Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.**

Successful candidates will bring strong SQL, Power BI, data modeling, stakeholder consulting, and KPI governance experience, along with the ability to translate complex business needs into trusted reporting and actionable insights.

Candidates with experience supporting SaaS, healthcare technology, commercial analytics, executive reporting, and modern analytics environments will be especially attractive.

- Translate stakeholder requirements into scalable reporting solutions and KPI frameworks.

- Prepare executive-ready analyses, presentations, and recommendations.

- Leverage modern analytics, automation, and AI-enabled technologies where appropriate to improve reporting efficiency and business outcomes.

Data Modeling & Governance

- Leverage SQL and modern data transformation frameworks to build scalable and maintainable analytics solutions.

- Apply data modeling, validation, and documentation best practices to ensure the accuracy and reliability of reporting products.

- Establish and maintain trusted KPI definitions, reporting methodologies, and governance standards.

- Partner with business and technical teams to improve data quality, consistency, and transparency.

- Support the development and maintenance of governed data products and reporting standards.

- Partner with business leaders to understand objectives, prioritize analytics needs, and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Facilitate requirements gathering and translate business needs into analytical and technical solutions.

- Drive continuous improvement of reporting products through stakeholder feedback and evolving business requirements.

- Share expertise and best practices that promote high-quality reporting, dashboard design, and data literacy across the organization.

- Support cross-functional initiatives that improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and business performance.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related field; or equivalent relevant experience.

- 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, or a related field.

- Strong SQL skills and experience developing reporting and analytical solutions using enterprise data.

- Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards and semantic models.

- Experience partnering with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into analytical solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

We are looking for a national sales manager with good communication, negotiations and team leading abilities with experience in medical equipment sales in India.
GE Healthcare Surgical Visualization & Guidance (formerly known as BK medical) is a leading intraoperative ultrasound company with a global footprint, providing customers with specialized real-time imaging guidance solutions for neurosurgery, urologic surgery, HPB surgery and more. Our solutions are tailored to enabling faster, real-time intraoperative imaging for surgical applications and are informed by clinical and procedural needs.

- Work with APAC Sales VP and Business Development Manager to develop and implement key strategies to ensure orders and revenues growth expectations in the territory.

- In collaboration with Marketing and Business Development Manager, identify and pursue new activities for specific surgical procedures opportunities at the same time in continuing to reinforce existing relations with users and institutions.

所辖区域的业务经营负责人和 SA 团队领导者，全面负责区域销售、订单、收入、利润、回款及长期业务发展。通过洞察市场、客户、竞争及行业趋势，制定区域业务战略，构建多元化医疗生态，领导和发展 SA 团队，统筹售前售后业务并优化资源配置；在复杂竞争和业务转型环境中推动重大客户和战略项目，实现客户价值、组织能力与区域业务的长期可持续增长。

Job Description
岗位职责
1. 制定区域战略并达成业务目标 : 全面负责区域销售、订单、收入、利润及回款等核心业务目标；洞察客户需求、市场竞争、政策及行业趋势，制定并动态调整区域战略和业务规划，推动设备、服务、升级、数字化及整体解决方案持续增长。

2. 领导 SA 团队并建设组织能力 : 领导 SA 团队达成业务目标，明确方向、重点及执行要求；负责人才识别、辅导培养、绩效管理及梯队建设，持续提升团队能力和组织战斗力。

3. 构建区域生态并深化战略客户经营 : 构建政府、医疗机构、KOL、渠道等区域生态，规划战略客户布局和覆盖策略；指导 SA 深化客户经营，并对重大客户、复杂项目及关键机会提供战略和决策支持，提升区域市场地位和品牌影响力。

4. 统筹售前售后，实现客户全生命周期经营 : 推动售前、售后围绕统一客户战略协同，关注项目成交、交付、服务、客户满意度及 NPS；将客户体验转化为续购、增购和长期合作，实现客户全生命周期价值最大化。

5. 优化渠道战略与区域商业生态 : 制定并推动区域渠道战略，优化渠道布局、能力及合作机制，促进直销与渠道协同，提升市场覆盖和运营效率，建立健康、可持续的区域商业生态。

6. 优化资源配置并强化业务运营协同 : 根据区域战略和业务优先级配置销售、临床、应用、市场等内外部资源，解决跨团队关键问题；强化重点业务和项目的计划、执行、跟踪及复盘，推动资源聚焦战略客户和重点机会。

7. 引领变化与业务转型，践行领导力价值观 : 洞察行业趋势、新技术及商业模式变化，推动最佳实践、流程优化和创新落地；以公平正直、积极正面和表率榜样的方式领导团队，坚持诚信、坚韧、好学，确保业务符合公司政策、业务机制及合规要求。

任职资格
1.本科及以上学历，7年以上医疗设备销售或市场经验；具备战略客户及区域业务管理经验，3年以上团队管理经验。

2.具备敏锐的市场洞察和商业判断力，深入理解医疗行业生态、客户需求及竞争格局，善于识别机会并推动业务增长。

3.具备优秀的学习适应、团队领导及人才培养能力，能够带领团队持续达成业务目标。

4.具备优秀的资源整合、跨部门协同及渠道管理能力，能够推动重大项目落地并提升区域运营效率。

5.具备高度的诚信与合规意识，能够有效识别和管理业务风险，确保团队及业务规范运营。

Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: No

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager - Ultrasound
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Customer facing staff responsible for winning business based at Visakhapattinam (AP). The role is subject to regular review of sales results. Some judgment may be required but this is typically with guidance. May be responsible for medium-sized sales territories.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description
Roles and Responsibilities
- Within a geographic area responsible for selling product(s), services, parts, solutions, or projects for Ultrasound business
- Developing in-depth knowledge of sales territory, product lines, markets, sales processes or customer groups. Uses prior experience and acquired commercial expertise to execute policy/strategy.
- In-depth understanding of key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work. In-depth understanding of how work of own team integrates with other teams and contributes to the area.
- Most decisions are within a defined framework, but some autonomy in the final decisions for a project, product line, market, sales process or customers. Uses prior experience and on-the-job training to solve straightforward tasks. Has access to technical skills and analytic thinking required to solve problems. May use multiple internal sources outside of own team to arrive at decisions.
- A job at this level is likely to be an individual contributor, with proven interpersonal skills. Communication with direct colleagues and the business about design and coordination services rendered. Provides informal guidance to new team members. Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations.

Required Qualifications
- Graduate degree from an accredited university or college.
- This role requires 6+ years of significant experience in sales and technical sales of ultrasound and other medical equipment.

Desired Characteristics
- Strong oral and written communication skills.
- Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.
- Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.

Inclusion and Diversity

GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

Disclaimer: GE HealthCare will never ask for payment to process documents, refer you to a third party to process applications or visas, or ask you to pay costs. Never send money to anyone suggesting they can provide employment with GE HealthCare.

Customer facing staff responsible for winning business Impacts approaches, projects and programs in the functional area or affected business organization and ways of working. Impacts quality, efficiency and effectiveness of own team. Guided by commercial practices and policies that may be shaped by the role. Has significant control/influence over commercial priorities. There is moderate autonomy within the role to enter into/execute Commercial arrangements. High levels of Commercial judgement are required to achieve outcomes required.

Job Description
角色与职责
- 负责在某个地理区域内销售产品、服务、零件、解决方案或项目
- 发展自己领域最新的商业发展的专业知识和沟通技巧，从而对他人产生影响。有助于战略和政策制定，并确保在责任范围内交付。通常是专业的一线经理或专业销售部门的二线经理。
- 对最佳实践以及自己的领域如何与他人融合有深入的了解；具有竞争的工作知识以及了解在市场上与众不同的因素
- 使用判断力来做出决策并处理项目、产品线、市场、销售流程、活动或客户中的中等复杂程度的任务或问题。对现有解决方案采用新观点。利用技术经验和专业知识进行数据分析以支持建议。使用多种内部资源和有限的自身功能之外的外部资源来帮助做出决定。
- 充当经验较少的同事的资源。可能会领导具有中等程度的风险和资源需求的小型项目。解释困难或敏感信息；努力建立共识。提升说服的技巧，以在领域内的话题上影响他人。

基本资格
- 该岗位要求在领域具有纯熟的工作经验。学力水平相当于从正规高等院校取得学士学位

所需特性
- 优秀的口头和书面沟通能力。优秀的人际关系和领导能力。具备分析和解决问题的能力。具备领导计划/项目的能力。能够记录、计划、营销和执行计划。良好的项目管理技能。

Customer facing staff responsible for winning business Jobs at this level operate with some autonomy but are covered by well-defined Commercial policies or review of end results. The job allows modification of procedures and practices covering work as long as the end results meet standards of acceptability (typically annual volume, margin and compliance requirements). Responsible for medium-sized sales territories.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description
角色与职责
- 负责在某个地理区域内销售产品、服务、零件、解决方案或项目
- 利用自身和他人的销售领域、产品线、市场、销售流程或客户群的深入知识，并运用分析思维和商业经验来执行政策/策略。
- 具有最佳实践知识以及了解自己的领域如何与他人融合；了解竞争以及在市场上与众不同的因素
- 运用判断力，并具有在设定参数之外提出不同解决方案的能力，以解决项目、产品线、市场、销售流程或客户的更复杂的日常问题。为决策制定信息优先级的能力。利用技术经验和分析思维。使用多种内部资源和自身团队之外有限的外部资源来帮助做出决定。
- 这些销售职位将主要由个人贡献者担任。
此级别的职位需要强大的人际交往能力。充当经验较少的同事的资源。可能会领导具有低风险和资源需求的小型项目。说明信息；培养使团队成员就领域的话题达成共识的技能。传达绩效期望，并可以处理敏感问题。

基本资格
- 该岗位要求在领域具有较丰富的工作经验。学力水平相当于从正规高等院校取得学士学位 （或根据相应工作经验具有高中学历）

所需特性
- 优秀的口头和书面沟通能力。优秀的人际关系和领导能力。能够影响他人并领导小型团队。领导中等范围和影响的计划。能够同时协调多个项目。有效的问题识别和解决技能。可靠的分析和组织能力。

Inclusion and Diversity
GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

jobs.title: Principal Solution Architect - Supply Chain Finance & Costing (Oracle Fusion)
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
This role is part of the IT Finance Systems team and provides senior solution leadership for Supply Chain Finance and Costing, including Intercompany, as GE HealthCare migrates from Oracle E-Business Suite R12 to Oracle Fusion Cloud. We are looking for a seasoned cost accounting and supply chain finance practitioner who has delivered multiple ERP implementations across industries and can bring leading practices that go beyond any single platform. The role shapes global design decisions, partners with Finance and Supply Chain leaders, and guides delivery of scalable solutions across product costing, inventory accounting, procure-to-pay and order-to-cash accounting, intercompany trade, transfer pricing, and related Record-to-Report processes.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description
In this role, you will
- Act as the design authority for Supply Chain Finance and Costing: define target-state business processes and the solution architecture for cost management, inventory accounting, and intercompany, including integration with Inventory, Manufacturing, Order Management, Procurement, Receivables, Payables, General Ledger, Subledger Accounting, and enterprise reporting.
- Advise Finance, Controllership, Tax, Supply Chain, and business leaders on leading practices in cost accounting, supply chain finance, and intercompany, drawing on experience from other industries and challenging current ways of working where a process should change rather than be configured around.
- Define harmonized future-state processes for standard costing, cost elements, overheads, cost accounting distributions, COGS, inventory valuation, manufacturing and purchase price variances, and period-end cost accounting.
- Design and govern trade and non-trade intercompany scenarios, including intercompany sales and purchases, internal requisition and internal sales order flows, transfer pricing, markups, cost-plus arrangements, profit in inventory, eliminations, settlements, and reconciliations.
- Evaluate solution options objectively, whether Oracle standard functionality, configuration, extensions, or alternative approaches, and own key design decisions, fit-gap assessments, process controls, and trade-offs.
- Provide hands-on application expertise, including configuration review, setup validation, prototyping, and conference-room pilots, and assess how configuration choices affect accounting, controls, integrations, reporting, and operational processes.
- Lead requirements decomposition and produce high-quality functional specifications, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, data mappings, and accounting requirements for reports, interfaces, conversions, and extensions; guide technical and integration teams on functional flows, accounting events, data, error handling, and reconciliation.
- Drive testing strategy and execution across system integration, user acceptance, regression, conversion validation, cutover, and hypercare, and support R12-to-Fusion migration including legacy process assessment, data conversion, reconciliation, coexistence, and retirement of redundant customizations.
- Own the solution beyond go-live, including stabilization, impact assessment of Oracle quarterly releases, enhancements, and continuous improvement.
- Provide technical leadership and coaching to product team members, facilitate decisions across workstreams, proactively manage risks and dependencies, and communicate recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
- 10+ years of experience in cost accounting, supply chain finance, or manufacturing finance, including ERP implementations.
- Deep, hands-on expertise in cost accounting and inventory accounting that does not depend on any one system: standard, actual, and average costing, overhead absorption, variance analysis, inventory valuation, COGS, manufacturing and procurement accounting, and period-end cost close.
- Led or held a principal design role in at least three end-to-end ERP implementations across at least two different industries (for example manufacturing, medical devices, consumer goods, or technology), covering costing, inventory, or supply chain finance.
- Proven ability to advise business stakeholders on alternative process models and leading practices, and to influence design decisions beyond what any single platform offers.
- Working expertise in Oracle Fusion Cost Management and its supply chain touchpoints (Inventory, Manufacturing, Procurement, Order Management), Subledger Accounting, and Intercompany (or Oracle E-Business Suite R12 equivalents), sufficient to validate configuration, run fit-gap assessments, and explain accounting, control, reporting, and integration impacts.
- Experience designing costing and inventory accounting solutions for a complex, global manufacturing and distribution environment, with strong knowledge of intercompany trade, transfer pricing, and cross-entity inventory movements and their accounting and reconciliation implications across AR, AP, Inventory, Costing, and GL.
- Ability to develop functional specifications and partner effectively with technical teams on reports, interfaces, conversions, integrations, and extensions.

Preferred / Added Advantage

- Direct participation in an Oracle E-Business Suite R12 to Oracle Fusion migration.
- Experience with phased deployments, hybrid R12/Fusion coexistence, and complex legal entity or ledger structures.
- Exposure to other ERP platforms (such as SAP) or cost management tools, which helps bring a platform-independent perspective.
- Knowledge of Oracle Cloud reporting, data, and integration tools such as OTBI, BI Publisher, FBDI, REST/SOAP services, middleware, and light SQL for analysis and validation.
- Professional certification such as CMA, CPA, CA, or ACCA, or Oracle Cloud certification.

Desired Characteristics

- Platform-independent thinking and the credibility to challenge and influence senior Finance and business stakeholders.
- Strong business acumen and the ability to translate finance requirements into scalable application solutions.
- Structured problem-solving, attention to detail, and the ability to assess downstream process and system impacts.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills across Finance, Business, Product, Architecture, Development, and external implementation partners.
- A continuous-improvement mindset with a focus on standardization, controls, adoption, and sustainable support.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
This role is responsible for leading contract negotiations with dedicated suppliers/providers to secure optimal commercial and contractual outcomes while maintaining strong internal customer satisfaction. The position requires evaluating complex business challenges, identifying opportunities for process and service improvements, and recommending best practices that drive operational effectiveness. Leveraging market knowledge and industry trends, the individual will provide strategic insights to support decision-making, enhance supplier relationships, and contribute to the overall success of the business.

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description
Roles and Responsibilities

- Proactively manage and mitigate supply risk by identifying vulnerabilities, assessing business impact, and executing robust mitigation plans in partnership with the PCS Monitoring Solutions leadership team.
- Lead supplier selection and readiness activities for New Product Introductions (NPI) and supplier transfer programs, ensuring suppliers can meet quality, delivery, cost, and cash objectives in alignment with program milestones. Partner closely with Supplier Management, Supply Chain, and Engineering teams to drive successful outcomes.
- Deliver sustained cost productivity , achieving annual product cost reductions of 8% or more through strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations, value engineering, and design-to-cost initiatives. Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing teams with a total-cost-of-ownership mindset while supporting logistics cost optimization efforts.
- Develop and maintain strategic supplier partnerships that create long-term value for both parties. Negotiate comprehensive supplier agreements, drive continuous supplier performance improvement throughout the product lifecycle, and lead Last Time Buy (LTB), claims, and lifecycle management activities with a proactive and forward-looking approach.
- Support supplier quality and regulatory compliance , ensuring adherence to FDA, EHS, transportation, and all applicable regulatory requirements. Champion supplier and component quality improvement initiatives that protect business continuity and customer satisfaction.
- Promote a strong culture of safety and compliance by leading and reinforcing safe work practices, accountability, and adherence to company policies and standards across all procurement and supplier-facing activities.

Required Qualifications
- Minimum of 15 years of experience in Sourcing, Operations, or Supply Chain and with a minimum of 4 years of supervisor experience
- Excellent business/financial acumen, ability to act as business partner through horizontal teaming, with the ability to motivate, influence and drive change in a collaborative way.
- Excellent oral, written and presentation communication skills.
- Demonstrated strong leadership skills delivering results.
- Strong interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to perform and produce results in multifunctional teams in a dynamic work environment.
- Highly organized and detail oriented.

Desired Characteristics
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Procurement or Supply Chain Management
- Experience as leader in an international environment.
- Experience in a high regulated industry (Healthcare, Pharma, etc.)
- Experience on Lean implementation and execution
